missing_month_rule: these calendar months have no CPS sample. calendar_month_index is absolute and prev_month_present flags rows whose preceding month is absent, so a lag or difference must filter on it. Treating consecutive ROWS as consecutive months produces a multi-month step labelled as one.

recodes.hours_rule: unconditional weekly hours, zero for the non-employed; employed-with-hours-vary UNOBSERVED, never zero; a genuine 0 is a real value and is retained

scope: W5 ANALYSIS PANEL. Not the pre-event power panel, which is frozen at 2021-11..2023-02 and feeds power_standard.json.
